description: Security rules for React Native bundle analysis

dependencies.title: React Native URL Parsing Vulnerability
dependencies.description: Incorrect URL parsing could allow attackers to bypass security controls
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade react-native to version 0.64.0 or higher

dependencies.title: Axios ReDoS Vulnerability
dependencies.description: Regular Expression Denial of Service in axios before 0.21.2
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade axios to version 0.21.2 or higher

dependencies.title: Lodash Command Injection
dependencies.description: Prototype pollution and command injection vulnerability
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade lodash to version 4.17.21 or higher

dependencies.title: Moment.js ReDoS Vulnerability
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade to 2.29.4+ or migrate to date-fns/dayjs

dependencies.title: React Native WebView Security Issues
dependencies.description: Older versions may be vulnerable to XSS and injection attacks
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade react-native-webview to version 11.13.0 or higher

dependencies.title: UA-Parser-JS ReDoS
dependencies.description: Regular Expression Denial of Service vulnerability
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade ua-parser-js to version 0.7.33 or higher

dependencies.title: Minimist Prototype Pollution
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade minimist to version 1.2.6 or higher

dependencies.title: Node-fetch Information Exposure
dependencies.description: Exposure of sensitive information to unauthorized actor
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade node-fetch to version 2.6.7 or higher

dependencies.title: Shell-quote Command Injection
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade shell-quote to version 1.7.3 or higher

dependencies.title: Async Prototype Pollution
dependencies.recommendation: Upgrade async to version 3.2.2 or higher

dependencies.title: AsyncStorage Security Improvements
dependencies.description: Older versions lack security improvements for data storage

dependencies.title: React Native Reanimated Updates
dependencies.description: Older versions may have stability and security issues

crypto.title: Encryption/Decryption Operation
crypto.description: Cryptographic operation detected. Verify proper key management.
crypto.recommendation: Ensure strong algorithms (AES-256) and secure key storage

crypto.title: Weak Hash Algorithm (MD5)
crypto.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger hash algorithms

crypto.title: Weak Hash Algorithm (SHA1)
crypto.description: SHA1 is deprecated for security purposes
crypto.recommendation: Use SHA-256 or stronger hash algorithms

crypto.title: Weak Encryption Algorithm
crypto.description: DES, 3DES, and RC4 are deprecated encryption algorithms

crypto.title: CryptoJS or Custom Encryption Helper Detected
crypto.description: Se ha detectado el uso de CryptoJS o de una clase personalizada de cifrado. Requiere revisión manual de gestión de claves.
crypto.recommendation: Verifica que las claves no estén hardcodeadas y que se use un almacenamiento seguro (Keystore/Keychain).

storage.title: AsyncStorage Usage
storage.description: AsyncStorage stores data unencrypted on device
storage.recommendation: Use react-native-keychain or encrypted-storage for sensitive data

storage.title: LocalStorage Usage
storage.description: localStorage is not secure for sensitive data
storage.recommendation: Use secure storage solutions for sensitive data

storage.title: Secure Storage Detected
storage.recommendation: Good practice - ensure all sensitive data uses this

storage.title: Realm Database Usage
storage.description: Realm database detected. Ensure encryption is enabled.
storage.recommendation: Enable Realm encryption for sensitive data

storage.title: SQLite Database Usage
storage.description: SQLite database detected. Ensure encryption is enabled.
storage.recommendation: Use SQLCipher for encrypted SQLite storage

network.title: Insecure HTTP Connection
network.recommendation: Use HTTPS for all network communications

network.title: SSL Certificate Validation Disabled
network.description: SSL validation disabled - vulnerable to MITM attacks
network.recommendation: Enable SSL validation and implement certificate pinning

network.title: No-CORS Mode Detected
network.description: Fetch with no-cors mode may leak sensitive data
network.recommendation: Review CORS configuration and data exposure

network.title: XMLHttpRequest Usage
network.description: Legacy XHR detected. Consider using fetch API.
network.recommendation: Use fetch API with proper error handling

authentication.title: Biometric Authentication
authentication.recommendation: Ensure proper fallback and secure implementation

logging.title: Sensitive Data in Logs
logging.recommendation: Remove sensitive data from console logs

logging.title: Development-Only Logging
logging.recommendation: Good practice - ensure __DEV__ is false in production

logging.title: Logging/Crash Reporting Library
logging.description: Third-party logging or crash reporting detected
logging.recommendation: Ensure no sensitive data is sent to these services

webview.title: WebView JavaScript Enabled
webview.description: WebView has JavaScript enabled - potential XSS risk
webview.recommendation: Disable JavaScript if not required, sanitize inputs

webview.title: WebView File Access Enabled
webview.description: WebView can access local files - security risk
webview.recommendation: Disable file access unless absolutely necessary

webview.title: WebView Bridge Communication
webview.description: JavaScript bridge detected - validate all messages
webview.recommendation: Validate and sanitize all bridge communications

deeplink.title: Deep Link Handling
deeplink.description: Deep link handling detected - validate all URLs
deeplink.recommendation: Validate and sanitize all deep link parameters

detected.title: Hermes Bytecode Detected
detected.description: The React Native bundle is compiled with Hermes bytecode, which limits static analysis capabilities.
detected.recommendation: Use hermes-dec or hbctool for decompilation analysis
